comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor elevations and labeled clearance dimensions are required to verify the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance requirement per UCM § 1.10.3.
applicableAreas: Building locations 1-8 relative to OHE line at southern boundary

comment: Clearance dimension lines showing 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors to all customer facilities must be provided on site plan and section views.
applicableAreas: Building locations 1-8 relative to existing overhead distribution lines

comment: Building elevation sheets showing all building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) with dimensions and clearance verification from overhead electric conductors are required.
applicableAreas: Building projections on all 8 proposed buildings relative to OHE line

comment: Building elevations with labeled clearance dimensions from overhead electric facilities in adjacent ROW must be provided, demonstrating both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances.
applicableAreas: Buildings adjacent to Valley View Road ROW

comment: Building elevation sheets must be submitted, including registered surveyor data showing surveyed conductor elevation and clearance dimension annotations for all buildings within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings 1-8 relative to overhead electric facilities

comment: Section and plan view exhibits must be added showing dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of each building and building projection for clearance verification per UCM § 1.10.3. Dimension lines must originate at the outside conductor location, not pole center.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings 1-8 and any building projections

comment: Dimension annotations must be provided showing fence post locations maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from existing electric poles.
applicableAreas: Proposed fence locations relative to existing electric poles

comment: Section views showing retaining wall elevations with dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of wall must be provided to demonstrate compliance with 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance requirement.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls in relation to overhead electric facilities

comment: Section views for retaining walls must be provided showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to wall face for clearance verification per UCM § 1.10.3.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls near overhead electric facilities

comment: Vertical clearance dimensions must be provided for the driveway where the OHE line crosses, showing minimum 16-foot or 18-foot clearance from the lowest point of the overhead electric line (including any attachments) to the finished driveway grade. Registered surveyor data for mid-span clearance verification is required.
applicableAreas: Main driveway entrance at southwest portion of site where OHE line crosses

comment: If parking or vehicle display areas are positioned beneath overhead electric lines, section views with labeled vertical clearance dimensions must be provided to demonstrate the required clearance (12 feet for residential pedestrian areas, 16 feet for parking without trucks, 18 feet with truck traffic).
applicableAreas: Parking areas in proximity to OHE line

comment: All clearance dimension lines must originate at the outside conductor (the actual electric wire), not from pole center or centerline of multi-conductor installations. On three-phase installations, the conductor may be several feet offset from pole center. Dimension line endpoints must clearly show measurement origin at the conductor location.
applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions on site plan where overhead electric facilities exist

comment: If sidewalks are positioned at or near existing power pole locations at the property boundary along ROW, clearance dimensions must be provided showing sidewalk alignment and pole location.
applicableAreas: Sidewalk alignment along Valley View Road ROW frontage near existing power poles

comment: Trees and other landscape features are shown positioned at or overlapping the overhead electric line on Sheet 31, violating the prohibition against installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities. All landscape features within the electric easement must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from the outside conductor. Trees positioned directly beneath the line must be relocated.
applicableAreas: Trees on Landscape Plan Sheet 31 at southern property boundary where OHE line exists

comment: Clearance dimensions must be provided showing water line routing maintains adequate separation from overhead distribution poles and conductors.
applicableAreas: Water line routing relative to overhead distribution poles and conductors

comment: If any building foundations are located within 5 feet of the property line, detailed dimensions showing clearance space for electric facility access and maintenance must be provided.
applicableAreas: Building foundations near property line adjacent to Valley View Road

comment: Registered surveyor data must be provided showing pole locations, overhead conductor elevations, and mid-span clearance measurements for the driveway crossing. This data is essential to verify the minimum 16-foot or 18-foot vertical clearance requirement per UCM § 1.10.6.2.
applicableAreas: Driveway where OHE line crosses

comment: If decorative lighting fixtures are positioned beneath overhead electric lines, clearance dimensions must be provided showing 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from the outside conductor, or alternative relocation notes.
applicableAreas: Decorative lighting fixture locations near OHE line

comment: All trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors must be from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list (ECM Appendix F, marked 'UC'). The currently proposed species (Live Oak, Cedar Elm, Texas Mountain Laurel, Mexican Redbud) are not utility-compatible. Trees must either be relocated to positions more than 10 feet from conductors, or replaced with utility-compatible species verified in ECM Appendix F 'UC' column.
applicableAreas: Trees planted at southern property boundary near OHE line (Landscape Plan Sheet 31)

comment: Enlarged detail drawings of proposed meter locations must be provided showing no obstructions to meter access and working clearances: minimum 30 inches wide, 36 inches deep front access space, and 6.5 feet headroom per UCM § 1.10.9.
applicableAreas: Electrical meter locations shown on Sheet 21

comment: If existing streetlight poles are located near proposed buildings, clearance dimensions must be provided showing building location and pole proximity.
applicableAreas: Buildings near Valley View Road ROW where existing streetlights may be located

comment: Down guy wire locations and anchors must be clearly identified on the site plan relative to all proposed accessible paths and driveways. Any conflicts must be resolved through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting steel poles, with details and relocation notes provided.
applicableAreas: Down guy wire locations relative to proposed driveways and accessible paths

comment: Dedicated easements for down guy anchors must be clearly shown on the easement exhibit, displaying 10-foot width and minimum 5-foot extension past where the guy wire enters the ground, per Austin Energy Transmission Engineering Standards.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor locations identified on existing survey

comment: A site logistics plan or construction phasing plan must be submitted showing staging areas, equipment laydown zones, crane swing radius, material storage, and scaffold locations, with explicit notation that all construction activities maintain minimum 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA 1910.333 and UCM § 1.10.2.
applicableAreas: Construction staging and equipment operation zones relative to OHE line

comment: A plan note must be added to the cover sheet or general notes stating: 'The owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines' per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.
applicableAreas: Cover sheet or general notes

comment: Six mitigation trees shown directly on overhead electric line on landscape plan, with no clearance maintained from distribution conductor and no UC status documented for proposed species in plant schedule.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary along Valley View Road where OHE runs

comment: Voltage classification of existing overhead electric lines not specified on plans. Cannot determine if transmission (≥60kV) or distribution (<60kV) classification applies, and therefore cannot verify compliance with 50-foot transmission clearance requirement.
applicableAreas: southern and western property boundaries where OHE shown

comment: Large trees (Live Oak and Cedar Elm with mature heights 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) shown directly on distribution OHE line on landscape plan, violating 25-foot minimum clearance from distribution conductors.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary OHE line where large tree mitigation trees are planted

comment: Voltage classification not specified. Cannot independently verify transmission clearance compliance without confirmation that OHE is transmission-class (≥60kV).
applicableAreas: southern and western property boundaries where OHE shown

comment: Utility poles exist on site but clearance distances from proposed trees to poles are not dimensioned or documented on landscape plan.
applicableAreas: western boundary where utility poles are located; all property perimeters where trees are shown

comment: Distances between proposed trees and underground electrical equipment not documented on plans.
applicableAreas: throughout site where underground electrical infrastructure and planted trees intersect

comment: Root barrier specifications, depths, and positions not documented for trees within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment.
applicableAreas: areas within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment

comment: Live Oak and Cedar Elm are large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) but plant schedule does not differentiate or identify them as large trees; only planting size (16' minimum) is documented.
applicableAreas: landscape plan and plant schedule for Live Oak and Cedar Elm

comment: No clearance dimensions provided on plans; measurement methodology cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: any area where tree-to-conductor distances are dimensioned

comment: No clearance dimensions provided on landscape plan; measurement reference point (trunk vs. canopy) cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: any area where tree clearances are dimensioned on landscape plan

comment: Trees are shown directly on overhead electric line, indicating zero clearance maintained from distribution conductor. No clearance distances documented or dimensioned.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary along OHE line

comment: Six trees positioned directly on overhead electric line without documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing the clearance variance.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary where mitigation trees are positioned on OHE line

comment: Transformer pad locations are shown but clearance dimensions to buildings are not documented. Submit detailed plan sheets showing measured clearances from each transformer pad to all adjacent buildings and structures.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations - Sheet 21 (four pads) and Sheet 9 (one pad labeled)

comment: Retaining walls are present on site. Submit clearance dimensions from transformer pads to all adjacent retaining walls, demonstrating minimum 5-foot clearance where applicable.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to retaining walls shown on Sheet 11

comment: Fences are shown on site. Submit clearance dimensions from transformer pads to fences, and identify transformer access door orientation to verify compliance with differential clearance requirements (5 feet vs. 3 feet per UCM § 1.10.4).
applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to fences on property boundaries, especially western and southern perimeter

comment: No reduced clearances (less than 5 feet) are documented on the submitted plans. If the applicant intends to use reduced 3-foot clearances to brick/masonry buildings, submit Austin Energy Design written approval and architectural specifications documenting 3-hour fire rating in the clearance area.
applicableAreas: Only applicable if clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are proposed (not shown on submitted plans)

comment: No balcony or overhang clearance documentation is provided. If balconies or overhangs exist above or adjacent to transformer pads, submit building elevations or cross-sections demonstrating minimum 5-foot lateral clearance and confirming no structures directly above pads.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to building balconies and overhangs (if present)

comment: No building elevations or transformer type specifications are provided. Submit building elevation sheets showing window, door, and ventilation locations, transformer equipment specifications identifying whether oil-filled, and measured clearance distances demonstrating compliance with UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 (12 feet minimum for oil-filled equipment when clearance conditions are met).
applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to adjacent buildings' windows, doors, and ventilation (if present)

comment: Sidewalks are shown on site plan. Submit clearance dimensions demonstrating minimum 2-foot separation from transformer pad edges to back of sidewalk per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations adjacent to proposed sidewalks, particularly the western pad near Bldg 2

comment: No fire escape locations are shown on site plan sheets. If fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes are present on the buildings, submit building elevations showing their locations and clearance dimensions from transformer pads (minimum 20 feet for oil-filled equipment per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4).
applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes (if present on buildings)

comment: Transformer pad locations are shown but access door orientation is not identified. Submit detailed site plan sheets showing transformer access door orientation and dimensions demonstrating minimum 10-foot clearance from hot-stick use area (access door side) to open area or adjacent building per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on Sheet 21

comment: No niche or enclosed area transformer configurations are indicated on submitted plans. If any transformer is located in a confined space (enclosed on 3+ sides), submit cross-section drawings demonstrating 15-foot vertical clearance per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: Only applicable if transformer faces confined space such as niche or enclosed area (not shown as proposed)

comment: Fire hydrant is shown on site. Submit clearance dimension from nearest transformer pad to fire hydrant, demonstrating minimum 5-foot separation per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to the private fire hydrant location shown on Sheet 10

comment: Tree locations are shown on landscape plan but species are not identified with ECM Appendix F utility compatibility ratings. Submit tree species list with ECM Appendix F 'UC' (Utility Compatible) designations for all trees within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads or 15 lateral feet of overhead electric conductors per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
applicableAreas: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment or 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors (tree locations shown on Sheets 31, 33, 34)

comment: Landscaping is shown on site but clearance dimensions from plantings to transformer pads are not provided. Submit detailed planting plan with dimensions showing: (1) minimum 10 lateral feet clearance from shrubs/vegetation to transformer access door side, and (2) minimum 5 lateral feet clearance from other sides, per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
applicableAreas: Landscaping locations relative to all four transformer pads shown on Sheet 21

comment: Trees within 20 lateral feet of transformers are not documented with root barrier details. Submit landscape detail sheets showing root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment) for all trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, particularly Tree 4034 relative to transformer on Sheets 33-34

comment: Dumpster or waste enclosure locations are not shown on submitted site plan. If dumpsters are proposed, submit site plan showing dumpster locations with dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: Only applicable if dumpsters are present (not shown on submitted plans)

comment: Bicycle parking is noted on site plan but specific rack locations relative to transformer pads are not dimensioned. Submit clarification of bike rack locations with dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pads per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: Bicycle parking locations relative to transformer pads (if adjacent)

comment: Light pole locations are not shown on site plan. If light poles are proposed adjacent to transformer pads, submit photometric plan with dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot clearance per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: Only applicable if light poles are located adjacent to transformer pads (not shown)

comment: Fire lanes are shown on site plan. Submit clearance dimensions from transformer pads to fire lane boundaries, demonstrating minimum 15-foot separation per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to designated fire lanes shown on Sheet 10

comment: Multiple transformer pads are shown on site. Submit dimensions showing minimum 5-foot clearance between all transformer pads per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on Sheet 21 relative to each other

comment: Water lines are shown on utility plan. Submit clearance dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot horizontal separation from transformer pads to water lines per UCM § 2.9.1.B.2.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to water service lines shown on Sheet 19

comment: Wastewater lines are shown on utility plan. Submit clearance dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot horizontal separation from transformer pads to wastewater lines per UCM § 2.9.1.B.2.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to wastewater service lines shown on Sheet 19

comment: Storm drain infrastructure is shown on utility plans. Submit clearance dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot horizontal separation from transformer pads to storm drain lines per UCM § 2.9.1.B.2.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to storm drain infrastructure shown on Sheets 12 and 19

comment: Underground utility routing is shown on utility plans but clearance dimensions from transformer pads are not provided. Submit clearance dimensions demonstrating minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical separation from transformer pads to other underground utilities (except gas, fuel, steam) per UCM § 1.10.5.A.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to all underground utilities shown on Sheets 19 and other utility plans

comment: Cross-section drawings showing vertical relationships between transformer pads, AE facilities, and other utilities are not provided. Submit utility cross-sections demonstrating that transformer pads and AE underground facilities do not cross over/under other utility lines, and that buildings/foundations are not constructed over AE facilities, per UCM § 1.10.5.B.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and AE underground facility routing relative to all other utilities shown on Sheets 19, 21

comment: One transformer is labeled as a vault configuration ('Vault Easement'). If this is a niche service installation, submit cross-section drawings demonstrating minimum 35-foot vertical clearance inside niche and niche entrance per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 3.
applicableAreas: Vault transformer near Bldg 8 (southwest pad with 'Vault Easement' label on Sheet 21)

comment: If the vault transformer is a niche service installation, submit: (1) architectural specifications documenting 3-hour fire wall ratings, (2) ventilation specifications, and (3) evidence of consultation with Austin Energy Design business unit per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 3.
applicableAreas: Vault transformer near Bldg 8 if configured as niche service (not fully documented as such)

comment: Cross-section drawings showing vertical clearances at transformer locations are not provided. If overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas exist above transformer access paths, submit cross-section drawings demonstrating adequate vertical clearance per UCM § 1.10.3 as required by Austin Energy Design.
codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (survey requirement as required by AE Design)
applicableAreas: Vertical clearance paths above all transformer locations shown on Sheet 21

comment: Transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified. If oil-filled transformers are proposed, submit grading plan notes and arrow callouts demonstrating that surface drainage flows away from transformer pads and building structures per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 1.
applicableAreas: Grading around all transformer pad locations on Sheet 11

comment: Transformer pad property location is not explicitly documented. Submit plan sheets with dimension callouts confirming all transformer pads are located 100% on private property and do not straddle property lines per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4.
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on Sheet 21 relative to property boundaries shown on Sheet 2

comment: Transformer pad locations relative to easements are not explicitly documented. Submit plan sheets with notes identifying whether any transformer pads are located in drainage, water, sewer, or electrical easements, and provide Austin Energy Design written approval if required per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4.
codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4 (property requirement); easement-specific regulations
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to easements shown on Sheets 2, 9, 11

comment: Transformer easements are not documented for most pads (only one 'Vault Easement' is labeled). Submit plat or easement exhibit showing transformer easement boundaries around all four pads with dimensions sufficient for Austin Energy accessibility per UCM § 1.10.3.
codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (additional clearance and access easements may be required)
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on Sheet 21

comment: Electrical routing property boundaries are not documented. Submit plan sheets with notes and dimension callouts confirming all electrical routing from transformers to meters is 100% on private property per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4.
applicableAreas: Electrical routing from all transformer locations to respective meter locations on Sheet 21

comment: Transformer pad detail sheets matching Austin Energy Design specifications are not provided. Submit AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for each pad showing: (1) service type (single-phase or three-phase), (2) pad dimensions (width x depth), (3) equipment specifications, and (4) any special installation requirements per UCM § 1.5.2.6.
codeCitations: UCM § 1.18.0 (obtain transformer pad detail from AE Design)
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations shown on Sheet 21

comment: Bollard specifications and clearance determinations are not provided. For all transformer pads within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle circulation routes, submit: (1) dimension callouts confirming distances to parking/circulation areas, and (2) bollard detail sheets showing 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts with spacing that allows equipment access door opening per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations relative to parking areas, drive aisles, and vehicle circulation on Sheets 9 and 21
